name: callout
description: Styled alert/callout box for MDX content with type variants: note, tip, warning, danger, success

ai.whenToUse: Use inside MDX content (blog posts, docs) to highlight important information: notes, tips, warnings, or danger alerts.
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't use as a standalone section — this is an inline MDX component, not a page section.

type.description: Callout variant: note, tip, warning, danger, success

title.description: Optional override for the callout title
